novel_features.name: Report delta
novel_features.description: See how one campaign's opens, clicks, bounces, and unsubscribes changed between snapshots — the trajectory Zoho never shows.
novel_features.rationale: Requires time-stamped report snapshots in the local SQLite store; no Zoho endpoint returns historical diffs.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Reach for this when asked whether a campaign's performance is still moving or has plateaued; needs at least two digest-written snapshots in the window — no instant trajectory on a fresh install.

novel_features.name: Org digest
novel_features.description: One-shot rollup of everything sent in a window: aggregate open/click/bounce rates, list totals, and biggest movers.
novel_features.rationale: Aggregates synced campaigns, latest report snapshots, and list counts locally — a dozen rate-limited API calls collapsed into one offline query.
novel_features.why_it_matters: The single command to call when refreshing a marketing dashboard or writing a daily brief; --since 24h gives the overnight change feed.

novel_features.name: List growth
novel_features.description: Per-list subscriber, unsubscribe, and bounce trend lines over time — is the list growing or bleeding.
novel_features.rationale: Built from periodic subscriber-count snapshots in the local store; Zoho only exposes current counts.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use for questions about list health over time rather than a point-in-time count; trends appear only after 'digest' has run at least twice over time.

novel_features.name: Engagement ranking
novel_features.description: Rank contacts by engagement across ALL campaigns — most engaged, or dead weight that never opens.
novel_features.rationale: Joins per-campaign recipient actions across every synced campaign; the API only exposes one campaign at a time.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Answers who the hottest contacts are before outreach, or who to prune, without opening 44 campaign reports.

novel_features.name: Bounce audit
novel_features.description: Bounced contacts joined to current list membership — deliverability cleanup candidates, pipeable into do-not-mail.
novel_features.rationale: Cross-campaign bounce actions joined to list membership exist only in the local store.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Run after event imports or before big sends to protect sender reputation.

novel_features.name: Contact journey
novel_features.description: One contact's chronological history across every campaign — what they received, opened, and clicked.
novel_features.rationale: The contact-centric inverse of Zoho's per-campaign recipient data; no single API call returns it.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Sales-prep lookup before a call: what marketing a contact has actually seen — reads actions cached by 'engagement' or 'bounce-audit', so run one of those first.

narrative.headline: Every Zoho Campaigns operation, plus report history, offline search, and headless self-refreshing OAuth no other tool has.
narrative.value_prop: The only open-source CLI for Zoho Campaigns. It mirrors campaigns and per-recipient engagement data into local SQLite and tracks mailing-list counts through digest-written snapshots, answering the questions Zoho's current-state UI can't: 'digest' rolls up a whole window for dashboards, 'delta' shows a campaign's trajectory, and 'growth' tracks list health. Self-client OAuth refreshes automatically — built for scheduled, headless, agent-driven runs. (Mailing lists themselves aren't cached offline — a known Zoho listkey quirk; list data lives in the count snapshots.)
narrative.auth_narrative: Auth is a Zoho self-client (api-console.zoho.com): set ZOHO_CAMPAIGNS_CLIENT_ID, ZOHO_CAMPAIGNS_CLIENT_SECRET, and ZOHO_CAMPAIGNS_REFRESH_TOKEN (or store them via config). Zoho refresh tokens do not expire, so access tokens mint themselves before every call — no browser, no re-consent, no recertification. Scopes needed: ZohoCampaigns.campaign.ALL and ZohoCampaigns.contact.ALL (READ variants suffice for reporting-only use).

quickstart.comment: Verify config and credential wiring; run plain 'doctor' for a live reachability check
Mirror campaigns for offline search; the report and list-count snapshots that power delta and growth are written by 'digest'
The org-wide rollup: sends, rates, list totals — dashboard-ready JSON
Recent sent campaigns with their campaignkey values for drill-down

troubleshoots.symptom: Response says status error with code 1007 or 'Unauthorized request'
troubleshoots.fix: Refresh token or client secret is wrong, or the account lives on another data center — verify ZOHO_CAMPAIGNS_CLIENT_ID/SECRET/REFRESH_TOKEN and that the org authenticates at accounts.zoho.com

troubleshoots.symptom: Error code 6101 'No campaign available in this view'
troubleshoots.fix: Not an auth failure — the status filter matched nothing; widen --status to all or raise --range
Zoho locks the API for 30 minutes after 500 calls in 5 minutes — rely on sync plus local commands (digest, engagement) instead of live loops

troubleshoots.symptom: subscribe returns 'Please give the correct data'
troubleshoots.fix: contactinfo field names must exactly match the schema from 'contacts fields' (e.g. "Contact Email", "First Name")

narrative.when_to_use: Use this CLI whenever an agent needs Zoho Campaigns email-marketing data: campaign performance for dashboards or briefs, mailing-list health, send history, cross-campaign contact engagement, or subscribing/unsubscribing contacts from automations. It is the right choice for scheduled and headless runs because auth self-refreshes without a human. Mind Zoho's rate limit in agent loops: 500 calls per 5 minutes, with a 30-minute lockout when exceeded — prefer synced/local commands (digest, engagement) over live per-campaign loops.
anti_triggers: Zoho CRM records (leads, deals, accounts, the CRM 'Campaigns' module) — that is a different product with different APIs
Sending one-off transactional email — Campaigns is bulk marketing, not a mail relay
Authoring or editing campaign HTML content — content work happens in the Zoho Campaigns web UI
